interface.shortDescription: Agentic design documents and editable workbench
interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, edit, version, import, and export Pencil design documents from natural-language intent. Includes Pencil Assistant, middleware tools, multi-page design workbench, layout and property editing, code view, draft persistence, and file export workflows.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Pencil design document for this product screen.
Create a realistic Pencil sample dashboard with complex auto-layout.
Import this .fig file into Pencil and summarize the pages.
Export the current Pencil document as SVG.
